The data included in this test set have been previously released via NCBI's GENBANK Database under various Bioprojects initated by CDC:

CDC Genomic Surveillance - [Influenza H1](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/PRJNA998879)

CDC Genomic Surveillance - [Influenza H3](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/PRJNA998880)

CDC Enhanced State Genomic Surveillance - [Influenza H1](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/PRJNA998884)

CDC Enhanced State Genomic Surveillance - [Influenza H3](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/PRJNA998887)

CDC Genomic Surveillance - [Influenza Intersubtype](https://dataview.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/object/PRJNA1262996)

CDC Genomic Surveillance - [Influenza Variant Strains](https://dataview.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/object/PRJNA1095492)

CDC Genomic Surveillance - [Influenza H5](https://dataview.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/object/PRJNA1095491)

Additionally, these sequences can be found on GISAID's EPI_FLU database as an EPI_SET: [EPI_SET_260106em](https://doi.org/10.55876/gis8.260106em)
